# UE4SS (third-party)

Vendored from [UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS), MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

- `bin/`: `UE4SS_v3.0.1-1181-g83330635.zip` from the `experimental-latest` release (commit `83330635`).
- `split-fiction-config/`: `Split Fiction` folder from `zCustomGameConfigs.zip` of the same release.

The experimental release is replaced on every upstream update, so the exact files are kept here to make builds reproducible.
